172.description: This vector represents sequential integers within a specific numeric range.

62.description: This vector represents Thai words, syllables, or subword tokens frequently containing the Thai consonant kho khwai (ค).

166.description: This vector activates on three-digit numerical sequences that frequently appear as telephone area codes.

88.description: These tokens represent common Thai language characters, syllable fragments, and grammatical particles frequently appearing at the end of words or sub-word token boundaries.

30.description: This feature vector activates strongly on two-digit numerical tokens representing integers or measurements.

50.description: This feature vector represents sequential three-digit numbers in the 180s and 190s, occasionally contaminated by unrelated noise tokens.

194.description: This vector activates strongly for mixed-script text containing a combination of English words and Thai characters.

56.description: This feature detects common Thai syllable endings, consonant clusters, and recurring sub-word tokens.

47.description: This vector activates on a random assortment of multilingual text fragments, non-printing Thai vowel markers, and numerical tokens with no cohesive semantic theme.

58.description: This vector is related to numbers ending in zero, particularly increments of tens, hundreds, and thousands.
